blocks.text: on — davom etish; off — tushirish, uxlab qolish, so'nish

140-darsda **on** / **off** ning «ulangan — uzilgan» ma'nosini ko'rdik. Bu darsda **on** ning ikkinchi katta ma'nosi — **davom etish**: harakat to'xtamaydi, «oldinga» ketaveradi. Asosiy fe'llar qizil kitobdan tanish: go on, carry on, hold on (→ qizil kitob, 121-dars). O'zbekchada bu ma'noga **«-(y)ver-»** qo'shimchasi juda mos: read on — **o'qiyver**, walk on — **yuraver**, keep on asking — **so'rayvermoq**. Darsning ikkinchi yarmi — **off** ning yangi ma'nolari: odamni tushirib qo'yish va kuzatish, uxlab qolish, ta'sirning so'nishi va xulq-atvor (show off, tell off).
on = davom etish: go on, carry on, keep on

**go on** va **carry on** — «davom etmoq»: + `-ing` (carry on **working**) yoki + **with** + ot (go on **with** the story). **carry on** biroz so'zlashuvroq, ikkalasi ko'pincha almashadi. **keep on** + `-ing` — harakatning **qayta-qayta, to'xtovsiz** takrorlanishi, ko'pincha bezovta qiluvchi: He **keeps on** interrupting me. Harakat fe'llari bilan **on** «yo'lda davom etish» ni bildiradi: **drive on**, **walk on**, **read on**. **drag on** — keragidan ortiq, zerikarli cho'zilmoq; **move on** — keyingi bosqichga o'tmoq yoki o'tmishni ortda qoldirmoq.

rows: keyingi bosqichga o'tmoq; o'tmishni ortda qoldirmoq

blocks.text: Muhim farq (→ 56-dars): **go on doing** — **o'sha** ishni davom ettirmoq: She **went on talking** (gapirishda davom etdi). **go on to do** — bir ishni tugatib, **keyingisiga** o'tmoq: She **went on to talk** about prices (keyin narxlar haqida gapirishga o'tdi). **go on** ning yana ikki ma'nosi: «sodir bo'lmoq» — What's **going on**? — Nima bo'lyapti?; «gapiraverib bezor qilmoq» — He **goes on about** his job all the time.

items.text: The rain didn't stop, so we **carried on** walking to the next village.
items.translation: Yomg'ir tinmadi, shuning uchun keyingi qishloqqacha **yuraverdik**.

items.text: Aziz finished school in Bukhara and **went on to** study medicine in Tashkent.
items.translation: Aziz Buxoroda maktabni bitirdi va **keyin** Toshkentda tibbiyot **o'qishga kirdi**.

items.text: Why do you **keep on** checking your phone? Are you expecting a call?

blocks.text: get on: munosabat va olg'a siljish

**get on** bir nechta ma'noli. **get on with sb** — chiqishmoq (→ qizil kitob, 121-dars), **get on** (well / badly) — inoq yashamoq. **get on with sth** — ishni to'xtalishdan keyin davom ettirmoq yoki kechiktirmay boshlamoq: **Get on with** your homework! **get on** — olg'a siljimoq: How are you **getting on** at university? — Universitetda ishlaring qanday? BrE so'zlashuvda yana ikki ma'no: **be getting on** — yoshi ulg'ayib qolmoq, **getting on for** + vaqt / son — ...ga yaqinlashmoq: It's **getting on for** ten.

items.text: Stop daydreaming and **get on with** your essay!
items.translation: Xayol surishni bas qilib, inshoingni **yozishda davom et**!

items.text: How is your son **getting on** in his new job? — Very well, he's already been promoted.
items.translation: O'g'lingizning yangi ishda ishlari qanday **ketyapti**? — Juda yaxshi, allaqachon lavozimi oshdi.

blocks.text: **on** ning yana bir nechta foydali fe'li: **take on** — xodimni ishga olmoq, ishni zimmasiga olmoq yoki raqib bilan bellashmoq; **catch on** — ommalashmoq yoki (hazilni, gapni) tushunib yetmoq; **turn on sb** — birdan kimgadir tashlanmoq, qarshi chiqmoq; **hold on to** — mahkam ushlamoq, qo'ldan bermaslik.
off: tushirib qo'yish, kuzatish, uxlab qolish, so'nish

**off** ning «ajralish» ma'nosi bu yerda turli ko'rinishda: odamni mashinadan **tushirib qo'yish** — **drop off** (aksi — pick up), jo'nab ketayotgan odamni **kuzatish** — **see off**, xatni yoki o'yinchini **jo'natish** — **send off**. Ongning «uzilishi» — **uxlab qolish**: **drop off**, **doze off**, **nod off** (o'zbekcha «ko'zi ilinmoq», «mudrab qolmoq»). Ta'sirning **so'nishi**: **wear off** (dori, og'riq, hayajon), **cool off** (salqinlamoq; hovuridan tushmoq), **tail off** (asta kamayib ketmoq). E'tibor bering: **drop off** ikki xil — to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa «tushirib qo'ymoq», bo'lmasa ko'pincha «uxlab qolmoq».

items.text: Can you **drop** this parcel **off** at the post office on your way to work?
items.translation: Ishga ketayotib shu posilkani pochtaga **tashlab o'ta olasanmi**?

items.text: Halfway through the documentary, Grandma **dropped off** in her armchair.
items.translation: Hujjatli filmning yarmida buvim kreslosida **mudrab qoldi**.

items.text: Kate was **told off** for arriving late for the third time this week.
items.translation: Keyt bu hafta uchinchi marta kechikib kelgani uchun **dakki eshitdi**.

blocks.text: Xulq-atvor va so'zlashuv: **show off** — o'zini ko'rsatmoq (Stop **showing off**!) yoki narsani ko'z-ko'z qilmoq (**show off** a new phone); undan ot yasaladi: a **show-off** — maqtanchoq. **rip off** (so'zlashuv) — shilmoq, aldab ko'p pul olmoq; ot: a **rip-off**. **go off** sb / sth (BrE) — kimdir yoki biror narsa yoqmay qolmoq. **get off** (with) — yengil jazo bilan qutulib qolmoq.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «carry on to work» → **carry on working** (`-ing`); «go on doing» va «go on to do» ni chalkashtirish (o'sha ish — `-ing`, keyingi ish — to); «keep on to ask» → **keep on asking**; «I accompanied him to the airport» o'rniga tabiiyroq — I **saw** him **off** at the airport; «He dropped me at the bank» — to'g'ri, lekin **dropped me off** tabiiyroq; «He boasted his car» → He **showed off** his car / He **boasted about** his car; «My teacher scolded me» — kitobiy, so'zlashuvda: My teacher **told me off**; avtobusda uxlab qolganingizni aytmoqchi bo'lsangiz, «I slept on the bus» emas — I **dropped off** / **nodded off** on the bus.

**on** ni ko'rsangiz «to'xtamay davom etyaptimi?» deb so'rang va o'zbekcha `-(y)ver-` ni qo'yib ko'ring: keep on asking — so'rayver, read on — o'qiyver. **off** ning bu darsdagi fe'llarini rasm sifatida eslang: odam mashinadan **ajraladi** (drop off), poyezd sizdan **uzoqlashadi** (see off), ong **uziladi** (doze off), dori ta'siri **ajralib ketadi** (wear off).
Bog'lanish: on / off — texnika, kiyim, rejalar — 140-dars; go on doing / go on to do — 56-dars; keep + `-ing` — 53-dars; get on with — qizil kitob, 121-dars; pick up ↔ drop off — 142-dars.

get on (with), move on, take on, catch on, go on (sodir bo'lmoq)
drop off, see off, send off
doze off, nod off, drop off, wear off, cool off
show off, tell off, rip off, pay off, lay off

examples.title: Continuing: **go on**, **carry on**, **keep on**
examples.description: **on** — davom etish: **go on** / **carry on** (+ `-ing` yoki with + ot) — davom etmoq; **keep on** + `-ing` — to'xtamay qilavermoq; **read on** / **drive on** — o'qishda / yo'lda davom etmoq. O'zbekcha «-(y)ver-» ga yaqin.

sentences.text: Sorry for interrupting — please **go on** with your story.
sentences.translation: Gapingizni bo'lganim uchun uzr — hikoyangizni **davom ettiring**.

sentences.text: Despite the rain, the band **carried on** playing until midnight.
sentences.translation: Yomg'irga qaramay, guruh yarim tungacha **chalishda davom etdi**.

sentences.text: If prices **go on** rising like this, we won't be able to afford a flat.
sentences.translation: Narxlar shu tarzda **oshib boraversa**, kvartira sotib ololmay qolamiz.

sentences.text: My neighbour's dog **keeps on** barking every time a car goes past.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnimning iti har safar mashina o'tganda **hurib turaveradi**.

sentences.text: Kate **kept on** asking questions until the teacher explained it again.
sentences.translation: Keyt o'qituvchi yana tushuntirmaguncha savol **beraverdi**.

sentences.text: We stopped at a café for a quick coffee and then **drove on** to Fergana.
sentences.translation: Tezgina qahva ichish uchun kafeda to'xtadik, keyin Farg'onaga qarab **yo'lda davom etdik**.

sentences.text: The first chapter was boring, but I **read on** and I'm glad I did.
sentences.translation: Birinchi bob zerikarli edi, lekin **o'qiyverdim** va bundan xursandman.

sentences.text: **Carry on** with your work — I'll just wait here until you've finished.
sentences.translation: **Ishingizni qilavering** — tugatguningizcha shu yerda kutib turaman.

sentences.text: How long will the roadworks **go on**? — Until the end of the summer, apparently.
sentences.translation: Yo'l ta'mirlash ishlari qachongacha **davom etadi**? — Aytishlaricha, yoz oxirigacha.

sentences.text: Even after his injury, Aziz **kept on** training because he didn't want to lose his place.
sentences.translation: Jarohatdan keyin ham Aziz jamoadagi o'rnini yo'qotmaslik uchun **mashq qilishda davom etdi**.

examples.title: **go on**: continue, happen, talk too much
examples.description: **go on to do** — keyin boshqa ishga o'tmoq; **What's going on?** — nima bo'lyapti?; **go on about** — gapiraverib bezor qilmoq; **go on at sb** — qayta-qayta koyimoq; **drag on** — cho'zilib ketmoq; **move on** — keyingisiga o'tmoq.

sentences.text: After studying law in Edinburgh, Sarah **went on to** become a judge.
sentences.translation: Edinburgda huquqshunoslik o'qigach, Sara **keyinchalik sudya bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: The minister spoke about the economy and then **went on to** discuss healthcare.
sentences.translation: Vazir iqtisodiyot haqida gapirdi, so'ng sog'liqni saqlash masalasiga **o'tdi**.

sentences.text: What's **going on** here? Why is everyone shouting?
sentences.translation: Bu yerda nima **bo'lyapti**? Nega hamma baqiryapti?

sentences.text: Something strange is **going on** at the factory — the lights are on all night.
sentences.translation: Zavodda qandaydir g'alati ishlar **bo'lyapti** — chiroqlar tun bo'yi yoniq.

sentences.text: Tom **goes on about** his new car all the time, and we're tired of hearing it.
sentences.translation: Tom yangi mashinasi haqida doim **gapiraveradi**, eshitaverib charchadik.

sentences.text: Please don't **go on at** me — I've already said I'm sorry.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, meni **koyiyverma** — kechirim so'radim-ku.

sentences.text: The meeting **dragged on** for four hours without any decision.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish hech qanday qarorsiz to'rt soatga **cho'zildi**.

sentences.text: Let's **move on** to the next item on the agenda.
sentences.translation: Kun tartibidagi keyingi masalaga **o'taylik**.

sentences.text: It's been a year since the divorce — it's time for Bekzod to **move on**.
sentences.translation: Ajrashganiga bir yil bo'ldi — Bekzodga o'tmishni ortda qoldirib, **oldinga yurish** vaqti keldi.

sentences.text: As the evening **went on**, the guests became louder and happier.
sentences.translation: Kech **o'tgan sari** mehmonlar tobora shovqinli va xursand bo'lib borishdi.

examples.title: Relationships and progress: **get on**, **get on with**
examples.description: **get on with sb** — chiqishmoq; **get on** — inoq bo'lmoq; **get on with sth** — ishni davom ettirmoq; **How are you getting on?** — ishlaring qanday?; **be getting on** — yoshi ulg'aymoq; **getting on for** — ...ga yaqinlashmoq.

sentences.text: Madina **gets on** really well **with** her colleagues, even the difficult ones.
sentences.translation: Madina hamkasblari bilan, hatto qiyinlari bilan ham, juda yaxshi **chiqishadi**.

sentences.text: My two brothers don't **get on** — they argue about everything.
sentences.translation: Ikki akam **chiqisholmaydi** — hamma narsa haqida tortishishadi.

sentences.text: Stop chatting and **get on with** your work — the report is due at five.
sentences.translation: Gapni bas qilib, ishingni **davom ettir** — hisobot soat beshda topshirilishi kerak.

sentences.text: How are you **getting on** at your new school? — Fine, thanks, I've made some friends.
sentences.translation: Yangi maktabingda ishlaring qanday **ketyapti**? — Yaxshi, rahmat, do'stlar orttirdim.

sentences.text: Jasur is **getting on** fast with his Korean — he can already read simple texts.
sentences.translation: Jasur koreys tilida tez **olg'a ketyapti** — oddiy matnlarni allaqachon o'qiy oladi.

sentences.text: It's hard to **get on with** someone who never listens to you.
sentences.translation: Seni hech qachon tinglamaydigan odam bilan **chiqishish** qiyin.

sentences.text: Grandpa is **getting on** a bit, but he still works in the garden every day.
sentences.translation: Bobom ancha **yoshga borib qoldi**, lekin hali ham har kuni bog'da ishlaydi.

sentences.text: It was **getting on for** midnight when the guests finally left.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar nihoyat ketganda yarim tunga **yaqinlashib qolgan edi**.

sentences.text: Right, let's **get on with** the lesson — we've wasted enough time.
sentences.translation: Xo'p, darsni **davom ettiraylik** — yetarlicha vaqt yo'qotdik.

sentences.text: Emma and her stepfather didn't **get on** at first, but now they're close.
sentences.translation: Emma va o'gay otasi avvaliga **chiqisholmagan**, lekin hozir ular yaqin.

examples.title: More with **on**: **take on**, **catch on**, **turn on**
examples.description: **take on** — (xodim) ishga olmoq; (ish, mas'uliyat) zimmasiga olmoq; (raqib bilan) bellashmoq; **catch on** — ommalashmoq; tushunib yetmoq; **turn on sb** — birdan tashlanmoq, qarshi chiqmoq; **hold on to** — mahkam ushlamoq.

sentences.text: The hotel is **taking on** extra staff for the summer season.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona yozgi mavsum uchun qo'shimcha xodim **ishga olyapti**.

sentences.text: Bekzod has **taken on** too much work, and now he's exhausted.
sentences.translation: Bekzod juda ko'p ishni **zimmasiga olgan**, endi holdan toygan.

sentences.text: Our small local team will **take on** the champions in the next round.
sentences.translation: Kichik mahalliy jamoamiz keyingi bosqichda chempionlar bilan **bellashadi**.

sentences.text: Electric scooters **caught on** very quickly in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Elektr samokatlar Toshkentda juda tez **ommalashdi**.

sentences.text: It took Oliver a while to **catch on**, but then he started laughing too.
sentences.translation: Oliver **tushunib yetguncha** biroz vaqt o'tdi, keyin u ham kula boshladi.

sentences.text: The dog suddenly **turned on** its owner and bit his hand.
sentences.translation: It birdan egasiga **tashlanib**, qo'lini tishlab oldi.

sentences.text: **Hold on to** the rail — the boat is going to rock a lot.
sentences.translation: Panjarani **mahkam ushlang** — qayiq qattiq chayqaladi.

sentences.text: Do you think this new social network will **catch on**, or will it disappear?
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, bu yangi ijtimoiy tarmoq **ommalashadimi** yoki yo'qolib ketadimi?

sentences.text: **Taking on** a mortgage at twenty-two was a big decision for Nilufar.
sentences.translation: Yigirma ikki yoshda ipotekani **zimmasiga olish** Nilufar uchun katta qaror edi.

sentences.text: When the company was criticised, the employees **turned on** their manager.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya tanqid qilinganda, xodimlar menejeriga **qarshi chiqishdi**.

examples.title: Lifts and goodbyes: **drop off**, **see off**, **send off**
examples.description: **drop off** — (mashinada) tushirib qo'ymoq; (narsani) topshirib ketmoq; **see off** — kuzatib qo'ymoq; **send off** — (xat, ariza) jo'natmoq; (futbolda) maydondan chetlatmoq; **pick up** ↔ **drop off**.

sentences.text: Could you **drop** me **off** outside the bank? I need to get some cash.
sentences.translation: Meni bank oldida **tushirib qo'ya olasizmi**? Naqd pul olishim kerak.

sentences.text: I **dropped** the kids **off** at school and went straight to the office.
sentences.translation: Bolalarni maktabga **tashlab qo'yib**, to'g'ri ofisga bordim.

sentences.text: You can **drop off** your old clothes at the charity shop on the corner.
sentences.translation: Eski kiyimlaringizni muyulishdagi xayriya do'koniga **topshirib ketishingiz** mumkin.

sentences.text: Half the village came to the station to **see** the newly-weds **off**.
sentences.translation: Kelin-kuyovni **kuzatib qo'yish** uchun vokzalga qishloqning yarmi keldi.

sentences.text: We **saw** Kate **off** at Heathrow and then drove back to London in silence.
sentences.translation: Keytni Xitrouda **kuzatib qo'ydik**, keyin Londonga jimgina qaytdik.

sentences.text: Have you **sent off** your application to Oxford yet?
sentences.translation: Oksfordga arizangni **jo'natdingmi**?

sentences.text: The defender was **sent off** for a terrible tackle in the first half.
sentences.translation: Himoyachi birinchi bo'limdagi qo'pol harakati uchun maydondan **chetlatildi**.

sentences.text: I'll **pick** you **up** at seven and **drop** you **off** after the concert.
sentences.translation: Seni soat yettida **olib ketaman**, konsertdan keyin **tashlab qo'yaman**.

sentences.text: Please **drop off** the keys at reception when you check out.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, xonani topshirayotganda kalitlarni qabulxonaga **qoldirib keting**.

sentences.text: Nobody came to **see** James **off** when he left for Australia, which made him sad.
sentences.translation: Jeyms Avstraliyaga ketayotganda uni hech kim **kuzatgani** kelmadi, bu uni xafa qildi.

examples.title: Falling asleep and fading: **doze off**, **wear off**
examples.description: **drop off** / **doze off** / **nod off** — mudrab qolmoq, ko'zi ilinmoq; **wear off** — (dori ta'siri, og'riq, hayajon) asta o'tib ketmoq; **cool off** — salqinlamoq; hovuridan tushmoq; **tail off** — asta kamayib ketmoq.

sentences.text: Grandpa usually **drops off** in front of the TV after dinner.
sentences.translation: Bobom odatda kechki ovqatdan keyin televizor oldida **mudrab qoladi**.

sentences.text: The lecture was so dull that half the students **dozed off**.
sentences.translation: Ma'ruza shunchalik zerikarli ediki, talabalarning yarmi **mudrab qoldi**.

sentences.text: I must have **nodded off** on the train, because I missed my stop.
sentences.translation: Poyezdda **ko'zim ilinib qolgan** bo'lsa kerak, bekatimdan o'tib ketibman.

sentences.text: Don't let me **drop off** — I need to finish this report tonight.
sentences.translation: **Uxlab qolishimga** yo'l qo'yma — bu hisobotni bugun kechqurun tugatishim kerak.

sentences.text: The painkiller is starting to **wear off**, and my tooth hurts again.
sentences.translation: Og'riq qoldiruvchi dorining ta'siri **o'tib boryapti**, tishim yana og'riyapti.

sentences.text: The excitement of living in a big city soon **wore off** for Dilnoza.
sentences.translation: Katta shaharda yashash hayajoni Dilnoza uchun tez orada **so'nib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Let's go for a swim to **cool off** — it's thirty-eight degrees in the shade!
sentences.translation: Suzib **salqinlab olaylik** — soyada o'ttiz sakkiz daraja-ku!

sentences.text: Sales usually **tail off** after New Year, so the shop has a big sale in January.
sentences.translation: Yangi yildan keyin savdo odatda **pasayib ketadi**, shuning uchun do'kon yanvarda katta chegirma qiladi.

sentences.text: Leave him alone for an hour — he needs to **cool off** after the argument.
sentences.translation: Uni bir soat tinch qo'y — tortishuvdan keyin **hovuridan tushishi** kerak.

sentences.text: By the time the effect of the coffee **wore off**, it was already three in the morning.
sentences.translation: Qahvaning ta'siri **tarqaganda** soat allaqachon tungi uch edi.

examples.title: Bad behaviour: **show off**, **tell off**, **rip off**
examples.description: **show off** — maqtanmoq; ko'z-ko'z qilmoq; **tell off** — koyimoq; **rip off** — (so'zlashuv) shilmoq; **go off sth** (BrE) — yoqmay qolmoq; **lay off** — ishdan bo'shatmoq; **get off** (with) — yengil jazo bilan qutulmoq; **pay off** — o'zini oqlamoq.

sentences.text: Stop **showing off** — nobody cares how much your watch cost!
sentences.translation: **Maqtanishni** bas qil — soating qancha turganini hech kim qiziqtirmaydi!

sentences.text: Jasur drove up and down the street to **show off** his new car.
sentences.translation: Jasur yangi mashinasini **ko'z-ko'z qilish** uchun ko'chada u yoqdan-bu yoqqa haydadi.

sentences.text: The teacher **told** the boys **off** for using their phones during the test.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi test paytida telefon ishlatgani uchun bolalarni **koyidi**.

sentences.text: If your boss **tells** you **off** in front of everyone, how do you react?
sentences.translation: Boshlig'ingiz sizni hammaning oldida **urishsa**, qanday munosabat bildirasiz?

sentences.text: Fifty pounds for a taxi from the airport? You've been **ripped off**!
sentences.translation: Aeroportdan taksiga ellik funt? Sizni **shilishibdi**!

sentences.text: I used to love spicy food, but I've **gone off** it since I got ill.
sentences.translation: Avval achchiq taomlarni yaxshi ko'rardim, lekin kasal bo'lganimdan beri **yoqmay qoldi**.

sentences.text: The factory **laid off** two hundred workers when the orders stopped coming.
sentences.translation: Buyurtmalar kelmay qolgach, zavod ikki yuz ishchini **ishdan bo'shatdi**.

sentences.text: The driver **got off** with a small fine, although he'd been driving too fast.
sentences.translation: Haydovchi juda tez haydagan bo'lsa ham, kichik jarima bilan **qutulib qoldi**.

sentences.text: All those hours of practice finally **paid off** when Madina won the competition.
sentences.translation: Madina tanlovda g'olib bo'lganda, shuncha soatlik mashqlari nihoyat **o'zini oqladi**.

sentences.text: Why does Emma always **show off** when her ex-boyfriend is around?
sentences.translation: Nega Emma sobiq yigiti atrofda bo'lsa, doim **o'zini ko'rsatishga** urinadi?

examples.title: Mixed: a long day at the office
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: bitta ish kuni hikoyasi — on (davom etish, get on with) va off (drop off, doze off, tell off, show off, wear off, pay off).

sentences.text: Oliver **dropped** his daughter **off** at nursery and hurried to the office.
sentences.translation: Oliver qizini bog'chaga **tashlab qo'ydi** va ofisga shoshildi.

sentences.text: The morning meeting **went on** for so long that he nearly **dozed off**.
sentences.translation: Ertalabki yig'ilish shunchalik **cho'zildiki**, u sal bo'lmasa **mudrab qolardi**.

sentences.text: His boss **told** him **off** for checking his phone during the presentation.
sentences.translation: Taqdimot paytida telefoniga qaragani uchun boshlig'i uni **koyidi**.

sentences.text: After lunch he decided to stop complaining and **get on with** his report.
sentences.translation: Tushlikdan keyin u nolishni bas qilib, hisobotini **davom ettirishga** qaror qildi.

sentences.text: A new colleague kept **showing off** her photos from Japan, which annoyed everyone.
sentences.translation: Yangi hamkasb Yaponiyadan olgan suratlarini **ko'z-ko'z qilaverdi**, bu hammaning g'ashiga tegdi.

sentences.text: Fortunately, Oliver **gets on** well with most of his team.
sentences.translation: Baxtiga, Oliver jamoasining aksariyati bilan yaxshi **chiqishadi**.

sentences.text: By six his headache tablets had **worn off**, but he **carried on** working.
sentences.translation: Soat oltiga kelib bosh og'rig'i tabletkalarining ta'siri **o'tib ketgan edi**, lekin u ishlashda **davom etdi**.

sentences.text: His hard work **paid off**: the director loved the report.
sentences.translation: Mehnati **o'zini oqladi**: direktorga hisobot juda yoqdi.

sentences.text: On the train home, Oliver **nodded off** and almost missed his station.
sentences.translation: Uyga qaytayotganda poyezdda Oliverning **ko'zi ilinib**, bekatidan o'tib ketishiga sal qoldi.

sentences.text: When he finally got home, he decided that he couldn't **go on** working such long hours.
sentences.translation: Nihoyat uyga kelganda, u bunday uzoq soatlar ishlashda **davom eta olmasligini** tushundi.
